name: Azur Lodge
positioning: Small hillside lodge of stand-alone villas above Queenstown, looking over Lake Wakatipu to the Remarkables
best_for: Couples who want a private villa with lake and mountain views
Travelers using Queenstown as a base for skiing, hiking and adventure activities

facts.text: The lodge sits on a hilltop with panoramic views.
The lodge and its villas sit on a steep hillside 3km west of Queenstown, with uninterrupted views of Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables mountain range.
Downtown Queenstown is five minutes away.
Each villa is an identical one-bedroom villa of 79 square metres of open-plan living, with a lounge, dining area and private sun deck.
The villas are stand-alone, built of stone and silver beechwood.
Each villa has individual climate control, including a gas fireplace and under-floor heating.
In-villa massage and mini spa treatments are offered on request.
Each villa has a yoga mat, and a private yoga teacher can be arranged on prior request.
In-villa dining options are available, and gourmet canapes are served in the lodge.
Azur is close to the Coronet Peak and Remarkables ski fields, the Shotover River, Glenorchy, Arrowtown and the winery areas.
The whole property, villas and main lodge, can be booked for exclusive use.

highlights.text: The bathtub in each villa is set into a bay window with unobstructed views, giving a feeling of being outdoors.
Uninterrupted views of Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables mountain range from a steep hillside just west of Queenstown.
Stand-alone villas built of stone and silver beechwood, each with a private sun deck.
Guests can stargaze from their private deck.

considerations.text: Children under 13 are not permitted at Azur Lodge.
There is a two-night minimum stay.
There is no gym on site; guests get complimentary access to a local Queenstown gym instead.
